content.user_title: Build Azure AI Search Solutions with Python
content.value_statement: Azure AI Search implementations require careful SDK configuration across indexes, vectors, authentication, and query modes. This skill provides focused Python patterns for building and reviewing those workflows.
actual_capabilities: Configure Azure Search clients with API keys or DefaultAzureCredential.
Define text and vector indexes with HNSW profiles and semantic configurations.
Upload, merge, upsert, and delete documents through standard or buffered clients.
Implement keyword, vector, hybrid, semantic, filtered, faceted, autocomplete, and suggestion queries.
Configure data sources, skillsets, and indexers for AI enrichment workflows.
Apply asynchronous clients and Azure SDK exception handling patterns.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and examples but does not execute or verify Azure resources.
Examples contain placeholders and may require additional imports, variables, permissions, and service configuration.
Embedding dimensions, models, fields, and semantic settings must match the target Azure environment.
Referenced supporting files and setup scripts are not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Add Search to a Python Service
use_cases.description: Create authenticated clients, upload documents, and implement keyword or filtered search for an application.

use_cases.title: Design Vector and Hybrid Retrieval
use_cases.description: Define vector fields, HNSW profiles, semantic settings, and combined query patterns for relevant retrieval.

use_cases.title: Build Enriched Indexing Pipelines
use_cases.description: Configure data sources, skillsets, indexers, and batch document operations for managed ingestion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Search Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a basic Azure AI Search Python example using DefaultAzureCredential. Include SearchClient setup, one keyword query, selected fields, and brief setup notes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner client setup and keyword search

prompt_templates.title: Design a Vector Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an index for documents with id, title, content, and a 1536-dimension vector. Add HNSW configuration and explain each field choice.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Hybrid Semantic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a hybrid search workflow using keyword text, a vector query, semantic ranking, filters, and selected fields. Include result handling and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Azure AI Search architecture for authentication, indexing, vector dimensions, batching, async usage, and error handling. Identify risks and propose production-ready improvements.

output_examples.input: Design a vector-ready product index with title, description, category, price, and embeddings.
output: Index plan covering keys, searchable fields, filters, sorting, and vector dimensions.
HNSW profile and semantic configuration recommendations.
Validation notes for embedding compatibility and index updates.

output_examples.input: Explain how to combine keyword, vector, semantic, and category filtering in one query.
output_examples.output: A structured query approach that combines text relevance, nearest-neighbor retrieval, semantic reranking, category filtering, selected fields, and result checks.

output_examples.input: Review a document ingestion flow that uploads large batches with an API key.
output_examples.output: A review recommending managed identity, minimum roles, buffered batch uploads, retry monitoring, partial-failure handling, and environment-specific load testing.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential for production and grant the minimum required Azure roles.
Match vector dimensions and profiles to the embedding model before creating the index.
Validate batch failures, close clients, and test queries against the target service configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys in prompts, source files, examples, or logs.
Do not reuse sample dimensions or field names without checking the embedding model and index schema.
Do not assume successful batch submission means every document was indexed.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides Python SDK guidance and examples that require your Azure service, credentials, permissions, and execution environment.

faq.question: Which authentication method should production applications use?
faq.answer: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential with minimum required Azure roles. Use API keys only when managed identity or Entra ID is unsuitable.

faq.question: Can it help with vector and hybrid search?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers vector fields, HNSW profiles, vector queries, keyword combinations, semantic ranking, filters, and result selection.

faq.question: Does it generate embeddings?
faq.answer: No. It expects embeddings from your chosen model or an Azure vectorizer configured for the index.

faq.question: Can it support asynchronous Python applications?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an asynchronous SearchClient pattern and recommends context management for client cleanup.

faq.question: Are the examples ready for production use?
faq.answer: No. Replace placeholders and validate imports, roles, schemas, dimensions, service features, retry behavior, and error handling in your environment.
